::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 29th [l887-1889]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

My dear [Mrs Wordsworth](people/person_1569.qmd)
I hope to come down to Salisbury by 2.24 on Tuesday, but as I owe an afternoon to the Moberlys, I will send on my goods and my maid to the Palace, and appear there myself at about 5 o’clock[^1]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Dating from after the death of George Moberly in July 1885, and probably dating from before the death of his widow Mary Ann Moberly in February 1890.
[^2]: Susan Esther (Coxe) Wordsworth (d. 1894) was the first wife of the Right Rev. John Wordsworth (1843-1911), who succeeded George Moberly as Bishop of Salisbury in 1885.
